_comoSeUsa: Formato NUEVO: la clave es la oracion. Para guardar: npx tsx scripts/saveSentenceTranslations.ts docs/sentence-translations/<journeyId>.json
_migrado: Convertido desde el formato por palabra por scripts/_migraTraducciones.ts. Las oraciones que quedaron sin traducir viven en <journeyId>.todo2.json.

sentences.sentence: Marina entró al apartamento con cara de que traía un chisme bien jugoso.
sentences.translation: Marina walked into the apartment looking like she was carrying some seriously juicy gossip.

sentences.sentence: “Parce, suelte ese aparato, que esto está muy bacano”, le soltó ella.
sentences.translation: “Buddy, put that thing down, this is really good stuff,” she blurted at him.

sentences.sentence: Según Marina, alguien del edificio andaba en un enredo tremendo con una vecina.
sentences.translation: According to Marina, someone in the building was caught up in a huge mess with a neighbor.

sentences.sentence: Valeria salió de la cocina con un tinto y se sentó a chismosear también.
sentences.translation: Valeria came out of the kitchen with a little black coffee and sat down to gossip too.

sentences.sentence: “Cuente, cuente, no me deje en ascuas”, la apuró, toda intrigada.
sentences.translation: “Tell me, tell me, don't leave me hanging,” she pressed, dying to know.

sentences.sentence: Marina bajó la voz como si fuera un secreto de Estado y arrancó con todo el visaje.
sentences.translation: Marina lowered her voice as if it were a state secret and launched in with all the drama.

sentences.sentence: Habló de mensajes escondidos, de una fiesta a las malas y de un man sospechoso.
sentences.translation: She talked about hidden messages, a party thrown on the sly, and a suspicious guy.

sentences.sentence: Julián por fin soltó el celular, ya bien enganchado en el cuento.
sentences.translation: Julián finally put his phone down, by then completely hooked on the story.

sentences.sentence: Se quedó callada un momentico, atando cabos con cara de susto.
sentences.translation: She went quiet for a little second, putting the pieces together with a scared look on her face.

sentences.sentence: “Pare ahí”, los frenó de una, entre la risa y el sofocón.
sentences.translation: “Stop right there,” she cut them off at once, half laughing and half flustered.

sentences.sentence: Marina, toda achantada, juró que ella solo repetía lo que le habían rajado.
sentences.translation: Marina, red faced, swore she was only repeating the dirt other people had spilled to her.

sentences.sentence: Al final se rieron un buen rato del teléfono roto en que se volvió el parche.
sentences.translation: In the end they laughed for a good while at the game of telephone their friend group had turned into.

sentences.sentence: De boca en boca, una reunión familiar se había vuelto un escándalo de telenovela.
sentences.translation: Passed from mouth to mouth, a family get together had turned into a soap opera scandal.

sentences.sentence: Así aprendieron que el mejor chisme casi siempre es puro cuento inflado.
sentences.translation: That is how they learned that the best gossip is almost always pure blown up nonsense.

sentences.sentence: Julián llegó del camello bien cascado y con un guayabo del sábado que no lo dejaba.
sentences.translation: Julián came home from work completely wrecked, with a hangover from Saturday that would not let go.

sentences.sentence: Se tiró en el sofá jurando que esa noche no salía ni amarrado.
sentences.translation: He flopped onto the couch swearing that he was not going out that night, not for anything.

sentences.sentence: “No me manden a rumbear, parceros, que vengo muerto”, pidió con voz de trapo.
sentences.translation: “Don't send me out partying, guys, I'm dead on my feet,” he pleaded in a worn out voice.

sentences.sentence: Pero el parche insistió, y a las dos polas ya estaba prendido y hablando hasta por los codos.
sentences.translation: But the crew insisted, and two beers in he was already buzzed and talking nonstop.

sentences.sentence: Entre risas y guaro, la lengua se le fue soltando más de la cuenta.
sentences.translation: Between the laughing and the aguardiente, his tongue loosened up more than it should have.

sentences.sentence: El cuarto entero se quedó callado, y Julián sintió el frío de la embarrada.
sentences.translation: The whole room went silent, and Julián felt the chill of the blunder he had just made.

sentences.sentence: Trató de echar para atrás, pero ya el chisme estaba servido en bandeja.
sentences.translation: He tried to backpedal, but the gossip was already served up on a platter.

sentences.sentence: Uno del parche, más sapo que otra cosa, se relamió con la primicia.
sentences.translation: One of the crew, a snitch more than anything, licked his lips over the scoop.

sentences.sentence: Sabía que había metido las patas hasta el fondo.
sentences.translation: He knew he had put his foot in it all the way.

sentences.sentence: Llamó a Marina con el corazón en la mano para confesar antes de que le llegara por otro lado.
words: con el corazón en la mano
sentences.translation: He called Marina with his heart in his hand to confess before she heard it from someone else.

sentences.sentence: Cuando por fin se calló, Marina soltó una risa que lo descolocó por completo.
sentences.translation: When he finally stopped talking, Marina let out a laugh that threw him completely off.

sentences.sentence: “Tranquilo, güevón, ese secreto me lo inventé yo”, le confesó sin culpa.
sentences.translation: “Relax, dummy, I made that secret up myself,” she confessed without a shred of guilt.

sentences.sentence: La lección le quedó grabada: al que tiene la lengua floja, tarde o temprano lo cazan.
sentences.translation: The lesson stuck with him: sooner or later, a loose tongue gets its owner caught.

sentences.sentence: Nadie quería seguir bravo, porque la mamera de andar peleados ya cansaba a todos.
sentences.translation: Nobody wanted to stay angry, because the drag of being at odds was wearing everyone down.

sentences.sentence: “Hablemos sin rodeos y cuadremos esta vaina de una vez”, propuso ella.
sentences.translation: “Let's talk straight and sort this thing out once and for all,” she proposed.

sentences.sentence: Julián fue el primero en dar la cara y reconocer que había hablado de más.
sentences.translation: Julián was the first to face up to it and admit he had said too much.

sentences.sentence: Marina admitió que su prueba de la lengua floja tampoco había estado muy chévere.
sentences.translation: Marina admitted that her loose tongue test had not been very cool either.

sentences.sentence: El domingo, el parche se juntó en casa de Valeria con arepa y chocolate caliente.
sentences.translation: On Sunday the crew got together at Valeria's place with arepas and hot chocolate.

sentences.sentence: Valeria, que odiaba los pleitos, hacía de juez para que nadie se pasara de listo.
sentences.translation: Valeria, who hated quarrels, played judge so that nobody would get away with being a smart aleck.

sentences.sentence: Poco a poco, la bravura se volvió recocha y risa floja.
sentences.translation: Little by little, the anger turned into horsing around and helpless giggles.

sentences.sentence: “Marica, ya, dejemos esta bobada quieta”, soltó Julián estirando la mano.
sentences.translation: “Come on, man, let's drop this silly thing,” blurted Julián, holding out his hand.

sentences.sentence: El parche entero respiró, como si le hubieran quitado un bulto de encima.
sentences.translation: The whole crew breathed out, as if a weight had been lifted off their shoulders.

sentences.sentence: Sellaron el trato con un brindis de chocolate, chocando las tazas como si fueran polas.
sentences.translation: They sealed the deal with a chocolate toast, clinking the mugs as if they were beers.

sentences.sentence: Se despidieron con la panza llena de arepa y el corazón liviano.
sentences.translation: They said goodbye with their bellies full of arepas and their hearts light.

sentences.sentence: Acordaron una regla nueva para el grupo, medio en serio y medio en chiste.
sentences.translation: They agreed on a new rule for the group, half seriously and half as a joke.

sentences.sentence: Lo que se hablara en el parche se quedaba en el parche, sin soltar prenda por fuera.
sentences.translation: Whatever was said in the group stayed in the group, with nothing given away outside.

sentences.sentence: Marina se la apretó e hicieron las paces con un abrazo de esos que valen más que mil perdones.
sentences.translation: Marina shook it and they made up with one of those hugs worth more than a thousand apologies.

sentences.sentence: Ninguno quería quedar como el codo del cuento, pero a todos les daba hueva soltar la lana.
sentences.translation: Nobody wanted to end up as the cheapskate of the story, but they were all too lazy to hand over the cash.

sentences.sentence: Esa noche le tocaba a Mateo, y el muy vivales llevaba días anunciando que andaba corto.
sentences.translation: That night it was Mateo's turn, and the sly one had spent days announcing that he was broke.

sentences.sentence: Llegaron los tacos y las chelas, y él se puso a contar las monedas de su cartera con una lentitud sospechosa.
sentences.translation: The tacos and the beers arrived, and he started counting the coins in his wallet with suspicious slowness.

sentences.sentence: Renata lo cachó de inmediato.
sentences.translation: Renata caught him at it right away.

sentences.sentence: “No mames, güey, ni que fueras a quebrar”, le soltó.
sentences.translation: “Come on, dude, it's not like you're about to go broke,” she shot back.

sentences.sentence: Siguió choteándolo, y Pablo levantó la vista del celular para sumarse.
sentences.translation: She kept ribbing him, and Pablo looked up from his phone to join in.

sentences.sentence: Alguien propuso lo de siempre: hacer vaquita y terminar con el asunto.
sentences.translation: Someone suggested the usual: chip in together and be done with it.

sentences.sentence: Pero Mateo se puso a echar choro sobre que él ya había pagado la vez pasada, que le tocaba a otro, que las cuentas no cuadraban.
sentences.translation: But Mateo started spinning a line about how he had paid last time, how it was someone else's turn, how the numbers did not add up.

sentences.sentence: Pura mamada, y nadie le creyó una palabra.
sentences.translation: Pure nonsense, and nobody believed a word of it.

sentences.sentence: Ya los había tranzado igual el mes anterior.
sentences.translation: He had pulled the same trick on them the month before.

sentences.sentence: Intentó zafarse diciendo que había dejado la cartera en el coche.
sentences.translation: He tried to wriggle out of it saying he had left his wallet in the car.

sentences.sentence: Sofía no dijo nada; lo dejó cotorrear un rato, dejándolo enredarse solito.
sentences.translation: Sofía said nothing; she let him ramble on for a while and tangle himself up on his own.

sentences.sentence: Cuando lo tuvo montado en la mentira, le sacó la sopa: el sábado había ganado una apuesta y traía dinero de sobra.
sentences.translation: Once she had him deep in the lie, she got the truth out of him: on Saturday he had won a bet and was carrying money to spare.

sentences.sentence: “Eres un cabrón”, se rió Renata.
sentences.translation: “You are such a rascal,” Renata laughed.

sentences.sentence: La mesa se le vino encima con pura carrilla.
sentences.translation: The whole table came down on him with nonstop teasing.

sentences.sentence: No hubo defensa posible, así que al pinche Mateo no le quedó de otra que aflojar.
sentences.translation: There was no possible defense, so damn Mateo had no choice left but to pay up.

sentences.sentence: Así se cerraba otro jueves: el que se hacía pato pagaba, y encima aguantaba la burla hasta el jueves siguiente.
sentences.translation: So another Thursday wrapped up: whoever played dumb paid, and then put up with the teasing until the following Thursday.

sentences.sentence: En la banda de Sofía todos sabían que el reloj de Renata funcionaba distinto.
sentences.translation: Everyone in Sofía's crew knew that Renata's clock ran on its own time.

sentences.sentence: Cuando decía “ahorita salgo”, había que sumarle una hora, a veces dos.
sentences.translation: When she said “I'm heading out right now,” you had to add an hour, sometimes two.

sentences.sentence: Esa noche los demás llevaban rato echando raíces en la esquina, muertos de frío.
sentences.translation: That night the others had been putting down roots on the corner for a while, freezing to death.

sentences.sentence: Neta, era la reina de llegar tarde, y el grupo lo había convertido en deporte.
sentences.translation: Honestly, she was the queen of showing up late, and the group had turned it into a sport.

sentences.sentence: Cuando por fin apareció la morra, Mateo la recibió con una cara de falsa sorpresa.
sentences.translation: When the girl finally showed up, Mateo greeted her with a face of fake surprise.

sentences.sentence: “¿Qué pedo, ya te acordaste de nosotros?”, anunció, para que lo oyera toda la cuadra.
sentences.translation: “What's up, did you finally remember we exist?” he announced, loud enough for the whole block to hear.

sentences.sentence: A Mateo nunca se le iba la oportunidad de vacilar.
sentences.translation: Mateo never let a chance to tease someone slip by.

sentences.sentence: Los demás se sumaron igual de gachos, cada uno con su versión del mismo chiste.
sentences.translation: The others piled on just as mean, each with his own version of the same joke.

sentences.sentence: Pablo estuvo especialmente culero, contando la vez que los dejó afuera de un cine.
sentences.translation: Pablo was especially nasty, telling about the time she left them standing outside a movie theater.

sentences.sentence: Renata, sin despeinarse, sacó su pretexto de siempre: el tráfico, el trabajo, la vida.
sentences.translation: Renata, without missing a beat, pulled out her usual excuse: traffic, work, life.

sentences.sentence: Dijo que le había tocado chambear hasta tarde, como siempre.
sentences.translation: She said she had had to work late, as always.

sentences.sentence: Ya nadie se lo creía, porque los había plantado demasiadas veces como para tener crédito.
sentences.translation: Nobody believed her anymore, because she had stood them up too many times to have any credit left.

sentences.sentence: Lo raro es que esta vez no se defendió ni armó bronca.
sentences.translation: The strange part is that this time she did not defend herself or pick a fight.

sentences.sentence: Lo que ninguno sabía es que traía una movida preparada desde el lunes.
sentences.translation: What none of them knew is that she had a plan ready since Monday.

sentences.sentence: Dejó que la siguieran agandallando un rato más, tranquila, esperando su momento.
sentences.translation: She let them keep piling on her a while longer, calm, waiting for her moment.

sentences.sentence: “Está bien chido”, admitió Mateo, sin poder disimular.
sentences.translation: “That is really cool,” Mateo admitted, unable to hide it.

sentences.sentence: Los apantalló a los tres de una sola vez, con un movimiento bien chingón.
sentences.translation: She dazzled all three of them at once, with one seriously badass move.

sentences.sentence: El reventón terminó a las cuatro y amanecieron crudos, arrepentidos y felices.
sentences.translation: The party ended at four and they woke up hungover, regretful and happy.

sentences.sentence: Renata se rifó, y por una semana entera nadie le dijo nada de su reloj.
sentences.translation: Renata came through, and for a whole week nobody said a word about her clock.

sentences.sentence: “¿Qué pedo, ya te acordaste de nosotros?”
sentences.translation: “What's up, did you finally remember we exist?”

sentences.sentence: Después de tantos jueves juntos, a Sofía se le ocurrió una idea medio cursi: tomarse una foto de los cuatro para colgarla en el refri.
sentences.translation: After so many Thursdays together, Sofía came up with a slightly cheesy idea: taking a photo of the four of them to stick on the fridge.

sentences.sentence: Lo que nadie imaginó es que algo tan simple se iba a volver semejante desmadre.
sentences.translation: What nobody imagined is that something so simple would turn into such total chaos.

sentences.sentence: Mateo se aventó una pose de portada de disco que nadie le había pedido, convencido de que era el galán del grupo.
sentences.translation: Mateo threw himself into an album cover pose nobody had asked for, convinced he was the group's heartthrob.

sentences.sentence: Se puso hasta adelante, con una cara de mamón que dio risa.
sentences.translation: He planted himself right at the front, with a smug face that made everyone laugh.

sentences.sentence: Ahí estaba, parado como el mero mero, cuando en realidad se veía bastante chafa.
sentences.translation: There he was, standing like the top dog, when he actually looked pretty cheap.

sentences.sentence: “Te ves bien naco”, le dijo Pablo, sin piedad.
sentences.translation: “You look so tacky,” Pablo told him, showing no mercy.

sentences.sentence: Renata apuraba desde atrás, muerta de hambre, diciendo que se estaban clavando demasiado.
sentences.translation: Renata kept rushing them from the back, starving, saying they were getting way too obsessed with it.

sentences.sentence: La cagada llegó cuando apoyaron el celular en una silla, corrieron a la marca, y resultó que nadie sabía usar el temporizador.
sentences.translation: The screw up came when they propped the phone on a chair, ran to their spots, and it turned out nobody knew how to use the timer.

sentences.sentence: Qué oso.
sentences.translation: How embarrassing.

sentences.sentence: Se chutaron diez intentos antes de que saliera una decente.
sentences.translation: They sat through ten attempts before a decent one came out.

sentences.sentence: “Órale, ahora sí, todos quietos”, gritaba Sofía cada vez, y cada vez se movía alguien.
sentences.translation: “All right, now for real, everybody hold still,” Sofía shouted every time, and every time somebody moved.

sentences.sentence: “Ya, compa, es una foto, no una boda”, le contestaba Mateo desde el fondo.
sentences.translation: “Come on, buddy, it's a photo, not a wedding,” Mateo answered from the back.

sentences.sentence: La décima quedó toda chueca, con la mesa inclinada y medio mantel de protagonista.
sentences.translation: The tenth one came out completely crooked, with the table tilted and half a tablecloth stealing the show.

sentences.sentence: De perdis, esa sí los agarró a los cuatro viendo a la cámara, y a esas alturas ya les valía madres.
sentences.translation: At least that one caught all four of them looking at the camera, and by that point they could not care less.

sentences.sentence: Al final eso era el grupo: cuates con los que uno la riega, hace pendejadas y termina contento de haberlo hecho.
sentences.translation: In the end that was the group: friends you mess up with, do stupid things with, and end up glad you did.

sentences.sentence: Camila entró al bar tirándose en la silla, hecha pelota, y largó todo de una.
sentences.translation: Camila walked into the bar, dropped into her chair completely wrecked, and let it all out at once.

sentences.sentence: “Che, no doy más con este laburo, boludo”, disparó antes de acomodarse bien.
sentences.translation: “I can't take this job anymore, dude,” she fired off before even settling in.

sentences.sentence: Según ella, el jefe le mandaba un quilombo tras otro sin respiro ni un gracias.
sentences.translation: According to her, the boss sent her one mess after another with no break and no thanks.

sentences.sentence: Se quedaba renegando hasta tarde, reventada, mientras los demás rajaban a horario.
sentences.translation: She stayed late grumbling and grinding away, burnt out, while everyone else took off on time.

sentences.sentence: Encima el sueldo era una miseria, y con ese mango no le alcanzaba para nada.
sentences.translation: On top of that the pay was pitiful, and with that kind of money she could not cover anything.

sentences.sentence: Tomás la bancó en silencio, dejándola descargar todo el bajón sin interrumpir.
sentences.translation: Tomás stood by her in silence, letting her unload the whole low mood without interrupting.

sentences.sentence: Flor le acercó una birra y le dijo que se despachara con confianza.
sentences.translation: Flor slid her a beer and told her to let it all out freely.

sentences.sentence: “Está todo mal, es un garrón, me quiero borrar de ahí”, cerró Camila.
sentences.translation: “Everything is wrong, it's a raw deal, I want out of there,” Camila finished.

sentences.sentence: Se pasó tres semanas al horno, sin dormir, sacando el laburo adelante.
sentences.translation: She spent three weeks in the thick of it, not sleeping, pushing the work through.

sentences.sentence: Flor la frenó en seco con una pregunta que la dejó pensando.
sentences.translation: Flor stopped her dead with a question that left her thinking.

sentences.sentence: “Pará, ¿y por qué te daría el cliente más importante a vos, si te odia?”
sentences.translation: “Hold on, why would he give the most important client to you, if he hates you?”

sentences.sentence: El viejo la felicitaba por el proyecto y la ascendía a jefa de área.
sentences.translation: The old man congratulated her on the project and promoted her to head of the department.

sentences.sentence: El maltrato no era maltrato, era una prueba de fuego que había pasado.
sentences.translation: The mistreatment was not mistreatment, it was a trial by fire that she had passed.

sentences.sentence: El bajón se le dio vuelta y de golpe todo tenía otro sentido.
sentences.translation: Her low mood flipped right around, and suddenly everything made a different kind of sense.

sentences.sentence: Flor llegó bajoneada y Tomás se ofreció de psicólogo improvisado de la barra.
sentences.translation: Flor arrived feeling down and Tomás offered himself as the bar's improvised therapist.

sentences.sentence: “Contame todo, flaca, que para eso están los amigos”, dijo, muy pancho.
sentences.translation: “Tell me everything, girl, that's what friends are for,” he said, totally relaxed.

sentences.sentence: Flor arrancó a contar que el chabón que le gustaba era un careta total.
sentences.translation: Flor started telling them that the guy she liked was a complete fake.

sentences.sentence: La había dejado colgada dos veces y encima chamuyaba a otras minas al mismo tiempo.
sentences.translation: He had left her hanging twice and was sweet talking other women at the same time.

sentences.sentence: “Es un forro, sacátelo de la cabeza ya”, sentenció Tomás con autoridad.
sentences.translation: “He's a jerk, get him out of your head right now,” Tomás declared with authority.

sentences.sentence: El pibe se mandó una teoría larguísima sobre cómo funcionaba el amor.
sentences.translation: The kid launched into an endless theory about how love actually works.

sentences.sentence: “Vos tenés que hacerte la difícil, no le des bola tan fácil”, le aconsejaba.
sentences.translation: “You have to play hard to get, don't give him attention so easily,” he advised.

sentences.sentence: “Si te busca, que labure para conseguirte, no le regales nada”, agregaba convencido.
sentences.translation: “If he wants you, let him work for it, don't hand him anything,” he added, convinced.

sentences.sentence: “Sos un genio, Tomás, ¿de dónde sacás toda esta posta?”, le preguntó agradecida.
sentences.translation: “You're a genius, Tomás, where do you get all this real wisdom?” she asked, grateful.

sentences.sentence: “¿En serio este te está dando consejos de mujeres?”, tiró sin filtro.
sentences.translation: “Seriously, this one is giving you advice about women?” she tossed out with no filter.

sentences.sentence: Pero Camila ya estaba lanzada y soltó la bomba sin piedad ninguna.
sentences.translation: But Camila was on a roll now and dropped the bomb without any mercy at all.

sentences.sentence: “Flor, este pibe no tuvo una cita en toda su vida, es más solo que perro en la calle.”
words: más solo que perro en la calle
sentences.translation: “Flor, this kid has never had a single date in his life; he's lonelier than a stray dog.”

sentences.translation: “You're a genius, Tomás, where do you get all this real wisdom?”

sentences.translation: “Seriously, this one is giving you advice about women?”

sentences.sentence: , tiró sin filtro.
sentences.translation: , she tossed out with no filter.

sentences.sentence: En la previa, con música y escabio, Camila y Flor se pusieron a largar todo.
sentences.translation: At the warm up party, with music and booze, Camila and Flor started spilling everything.

sentences.sentence: “Estoy re mal, piba, conocí un pibe soñado”, arrancó Camila con una sonrisa boba.
sentences.translation: “I'm in really bad shape, girl, I met a dream guy,” Camila began with a goofy smile.

sentences.sentence: Flor casi salta de la silla, porque ella también venía embalada con alguien.
sentences.translation: Flor almost jumped out of her chair, because she was swept up with someone too.

sentences.sentence: Camila contó que el suyo era alto, canchero y con una labia impresionante.
sentences.translation: Camila said hers was tall, effortlessly cool and with an impressive gift of the gab.

sentences.sentence: Siguieron comparando entre risas, sin darse cuenta del bardo que se venía encima.
sentences.translation: They kept comparing notes between laughs, without noticing the trouble coming their way.

sentences.sentence: Los dos pibes las habían invitado al mismo bar, con el mismo verso trillado.
sentences.translation: The two guys had invited them to the same bar, with the same worn out line.

sentences.sentence: Hasta la remera que describían, azul con letras blancas, era idéntica.
sentences.translation: Even the shirt they described, blue with white lettering, was identical.

sentences.sentence: Flor se quedó dura, con el vaso a mitad de camino de la boca.
sentences.translation: Flor froze stiff, with her glass halfway to her mouth.

sentences.sentence: El pibe soñado de cada una era un chamuyero serial que las verseaba en paralelo.
sentences.translation: Each one's dream guy was the same serial smooth talker feeding both of them lies at once.

sentences.sentence: La previa alegre se pinchó de golpe con la calentura subiendo.
sentences.translation: The cheerful warm up deflated all at once as the anger rose.

sentences.sentence: Después del cachetazo inicial, las dos se miraron y la calentura cambió de destino.
sentences.translation: After that first slap in the face, the two looked at each other and their fury changed targets.

sentences.sentence: En vez de pelearse entre ellas, se aliaron contra el forro con una sonrisa peligrosa.
sentences.translation: Instead of fighting each other, they teamed up against the jerk with a dangerous smile.

sentences.sentence: Si el pibe quería jugar con las dos, iba a cobrarla doble.
sentences.translation: If the guy wanted to play with both of them, he was going to pay double.

sentences.sentence: Armaron un plan de venganza ahí mismo, entre carcajadas y trago va trago viene.
sentences.translation: They put together a revenge plan right there, between roars of laughter and round after round.

sentences.sentence: Nada cura un desamor tan rápido como una amiga con sed de revancha.
sentences.translation: Nothing cures heartbreak faster than a friend thirsty for payback.

sentences.sentence: “Resulta que el weón llegó con la weá, y le pasó la otra weá al otro weón”, contaba entusiasmado.
sentences.translation: “So the dude showed up with the thing, and passed the other thing to the other dude,” he told them excitedly.

sentences.sentence: Nico se cagaba de la risa con el weveo cuático que se armaba.
sentences.translation: Nico was dying of laughter at the over the top banter going on.

sentences.translation: Andrés drank the beer in one gulp and straightened his shirt collar.

sentences.sentence: Justo pasó una vecina, y Andrés le lanzó su mejor sonrisa de conquistador.
sentences.translation: A neighbor happened to walk by, and Andrés flashed her his best charmer's smile.

sentences.sentence: Andrés, lejos de arrecharse, se pasó la mano por el pelo bien orgulloso.
sentences.translation: Andrés, far from getting worked up, ran his hand through his hair, proud as could be.

sentences.sentence: Daniela le montó más chercha para sacarlo de casillas.
sentences.translation: Daniela teased him harder to push him over the edge.

sentences.sentence: El sábado la parranda estaba a millón, con champeta pegada y birras bien frías.
sentences.translation: On Saturday the party was going full blast, with champeta pounding and ice cold beers.

sentences.sentence: Andrés no le quitaba el ojo a una traga que bailaba sabroso en la mitad de la pista.
sentences.translation: Andrés could not take his eyes off a crush of his dancing with real flavor in the middle of the floor.

sentences.sentence: “Ahí está tu momento, galán, no la vayas a embarrar”, le dijo Yuly dándole un codazo.
sentences.translation: “There's your moment, handsome, don't go and ruin it,” Yuly told him with a nudge of her elbow.

sentences.sentence: Recordaba el corte tieso y el papelón con la vecina.
sentences.translation: She remembered the stiff haircut and the embarrassing scene with the neighbor.

sentences.sentence: “Esto lo tengo que ver, vale, va a ser un show”, le comentó a Yuly.
sentences.translation: “I have to see this, buddy, it's going to be a spectacle,” he said to Yuly.

sentences.sentence: Andrés se metió a la pista moviéndose bien descoordinada.
sentences.translation: Andrés got onto the dance floor moving completely out of sync.

sentences.sentence: El parche entero se dobló de la risa al verlo hacer semejante ridiculez.
sentences.translation: The whole group doubled over laughing at the sight of such an absurd display.

sentences.sentence: La traga lo miró de arriba abajo, como si lo fuera a dejar en ridículo.
sentences.translation: The girl looked him up and down, as if she were about to humiliate him.

sentences.sentence: En vez de irse, se acercó y le empezó a marcar el paso con paciencia.
sentences.translation: Instead of walking off, she came closer and started guiding his steps patiently.

sentences.sentence: Andrés no lo podía creer y por poco se queda congelado de la dicha.
sentences.translation: Andrés could not believe it and almost froze stiff with sheer joy.

sentences.sentence: Poco a poco fue agarrando el ritmo, llevado por la mano de la china.
sentences.translation: Little by little he got the hang of the rhythm, led by the girl's hand.

sentences.sentence: El perdedor de siempre estaba bailando pegado con la traga más buenona de la fiesta.
sentences.translation: The usual loser was dancing close with the best looking girl at the party.

sentences.sentence: Yuly, todavía en shock, murmuró un “No joda” y admitió que el milagro existía.
sentences.translation: Yuly, still in shock, muttered a “Come on” and admitted that miracles do exist.

sentences.sentence: Cuando terminó la canción, Andrés volvió al parche caminando en las nubes.
sentences.translation: When the song ended, Andrés walked back to the group on air.

sentences.sentence: No dijo nada, solo levantó las cejas con una cara de triunfo insoportable.
sentences.translation: He said nothing, he just raised his eyebrows with an unbearably triumphant look.

sentences.sentence: Daniela y Yuly se quedaron con la boca abierta, sin saber si reírse o aplaudir.
sentences.translation: Daniela and Yuly were left open mouthed, not knowing whether to laugh or applaud.

sentences.sentence: Ya de madrugada, con las birras calientes y medio mundo jincho, la parranda iba de salida.
sentences.translation: By the small hours, with warm beers and half the crowd wasted, the party was winding down.

sentences.sentence: Andrés por fin tenía el cuadre con la china y no lo pensaba soltar.
sentences.translation: Andrés finally had something going with the girl and he was not about to let it go.

sentences.sentence: La china se reía de sus chistes malos y le seguía el juego con gusto.
sentences.translation: The girl laughed at his bad jokes and played along happily.

sentences.sentence: “Míralo, el bobo por fin la está haciendo bien”, susurró Daniela sin poder creerlo.
sentences.translation: “Look at him, the big dummy is finally doing it right,” Daniela whispered, unable to believe it.

sentences.sentence: Yuly cruzó los dedos, rogando que Andrés no fuera a embarrarla en el último minuto.
sentences.translation: Yuly crossed her fingers, praying that Andrés would not blow it at the last minute.

sentences.sentence: Andrés bajó la voz y se armó de valor para lanzar la pregunta clave.
sentences.translation: Andrés lowered his voice and worked up the courage to ask the key question.

sentences.sentence: Estaba a nada de conseguir el número, con el corazón latiendo a mil.
sentences.translation: He was a breath away from getting her number, with his heart pounding wildly.

sentences.sentence: Justo en ese momento apareció el guachimán del edificio con cara de pocos amigos.
sentences.translation: Right at that moment the building's security guard appeared with a face like thunder.

sentences.sentence: “Se acabó la rumba, muchachos, a bajarle al ruido ya mismo”, ladró de mal genio.
sentences.translation: “The party is over, kids, turn that noise down right now,” he barked in a foul mood.

sentences.sentence: La música se cortó de golpe y todo el mundo pegó el grito al cielo.
sentences.translation: The music cut off all at once and everybody cried out in protest.

sentences.sentence: El guachimán se plantó entre Andrés y la china, como un muro imposible.
sentences.translation: The guard planted himself between Andrés and the girl, like an impossible wall.

sentences.sentence: Andrés le rogó con la mirada un minuto más, uno solo.
sentences.translation: Andrés begged him with his eyes for one more minute, just one.

sentences.sentence: Andrés se quedó con la mano estirada y el número a medio dar, sin saber si lo alcanzó a agarrar.
sentences.translation: Andrés was left with his hand out and the number half given, not knowing if she managed to catch it.

sentences.sentence: La conversación fluía sabroso, y por primera vez el pelao no estaba dañando el momento.
sentences.translation: The conversation was flowing nicely, and for the first time the kid was not ruining the moment.

sentences.sentence: Pero el hombre no estaba para vacilar y empezó a espantar a la gente sin piedad.
sentences.translation: But the man was in no mood for joking and started shooing people away without mercy.
